system.description:
Battle Amp

You embolden your physical strength to new heights, enlarging your muscles and reinforcing your brutal physique.

Colossus. Your size increases to Lear, melee weapon and unarmed attacks you make gain the Reach 1 Property, if they didn’t already. You make Athletics checks at advantage.

Muscular Overdrive. You gain the benefits of the Water Muscles Liquification techniques for the duration, at no Hydration cost.

Water Canons. Increase Cold damage you deal as a result of casting a jutsu with the Water Release keyword by +1 die.

Hydro Armor. You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing. Slashing, cold and fire damage.

Water Pressure. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a large or smaller creature, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Weakened and are knocked Prone
system.summary: Large, Reach 1, advantage on Athletics. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, cold and fire; Water Release cold damage +1 die.

rules.text: Start: Bonus action and 4 Hydration, for your chosen Tidal State (chosen each long rest). Once per rest.
Colossus: size Large and Reach 1 on melee weapon and unarmed attacks (at the table).
Water Cannons (+1 cold die on Water Release jutsu) and Water Pressure: at the table.
